name: OVR Technology
old_description: OVR has unlocked scent for video games with the Omara Scent Display.
about:
Based in Burlington, Vermont, OVR Technology develops hardware and software that add olfactory cues to interactive media. The company was founded by a team spanning industrial design, fragrance creation, neuroscience, and software engineering, though a founding year and ownership structure have not been publicly disclosed.

OVR’s core product line consists of the Omara Core and Omara Pro, personal scent displays that connect to PCs, mobile devices, and VR headsets via Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth, or USB. The Core model offers ten scent channels and a desktop form factor, while the Pro provides sixteen channels in a pocket‑sized unit. Both devices mix up to three scent channels simultaneously and deliver bursts or continuous streams, with a time‑to‑perception ranging from 500 to 1,000 milliseconds.

The technology targets video‑game players and creators, with explicit support for PC and VR titles. OVR also partners with independent studios worldwide to integrate scent into their games, providing a software development kit and scent‑cartridge system that lets developers trigger aromas in sync with gameplay events.

The company positions itself as a first mover in digital scent, emphasizing the difficulty of pioneering the category. Its stated differentiation rests on the integration of hardware, proprietary Scentware® cartridges, and a software layer that synchronizes scent release with real‑time game data.

name: OXOS Medical, Inc
old_description: OXOS is transforming medical imaging with innovative, portable X‑ray solutions
about:
OXOS Medical, Inc. is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. The company was founded in June 2016 as Micro C, LLC, later renamed OXOS Medical, Inc., by Evan M. Ruff, who serves as CEO, and Gregory P. Kolovich, MD, a reconstructive hand surgeon who became frustrated with traditional imaging processes while at Harvard Medical School. That frustration inspired the development of the Micro C, the world's first portable Dynamic Digital Radiography device for orthopedic surgery.

OXOS designs and manufactures portable X-ray systems, including the original Micro C and the newer MC2, which received FDA 510(k) clearance (K252068) in 2024. The devices are built around a low-radiation profile while maintaining high image quality, and incorporate the AiLARA system, an automated technology that optimizes radiation dose according to the ALARA principle. A team of engineers, designers, and clinical advisors supports development and commercialization, with the MC2 now available in the United States.

The company targets orthopedics, pediatrics, and sports medicine, serving clinicians and medical practices nationwide. Testimonials cite use by hand and upper extremity surgeons, orthopaedic surgeons for professional sports teams (including the Jacksonville Jaguars), foot and ankle surgeons, and at off-road racing events through the non-profit Safety On Site. The portable systems are designed for point-of-care imaging in diverse clinical settings.

OXOS states its mission is to allow anyone, anywhere to access radiographic diagnostics at the point of need, expanding availability and changing how healthcare is delivered. The company emphasizes three pillars: safety through low radiation exposure, simplicity via portable and modular design, and intelligence through real-time diagnosis enabled by optimized alignment and a no-fire positioning system.

about:
Obex Packaging, Inc. operates from Reno, Nevada, where it has served the printing and film industry for more than 20 years. The company is a family-owned business that emphasizes strong communication and customized products and shipments to address each client’s needs.

The company specializes in rotogravure printing for custom packaging, offering custom-built solutions to exact specifications. It also provides a stock packaging line in various sizes and materials, along with labels featuring anti-tamper features. Additional capabilities include die-cut pouches, inside-print security features, and hand holes for easier handling. Obex reports serving more than 250 brands, from startups to global industry leaders.

Obex works with a broad range of clients, including startups and established global companies across various sectors. The company’s packaging and label solutions are used by brands seeking custom branding, stock packaging, or anti-tamper labeling.

The company emphasizes building strong client relationships through communication and customization, aiming to exceed expectations by tailoring products and shipments to each client’s needs.

name: OceanHead Solar & Electric
old_description: general contractor, manufacturer, or in a government-related industry,
about:
OceanHead Solar & Electric operates from Honolulu on the island of Oahu, Hawaii. The company is a licensed Hawaii solar and electrical contractor (LIC# C-33164) founded by Gail and Chelli, who are described as the owners and power couple behind the business. It is certified as a Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB) and a Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE), and holds an A+ rating from the Better Business Bureau.

The firm designs and installs solar photovoltaic systems, battery backup, and electric vehicle charging infrastructure for residential and commercial clients. Its in-house licensed team manages projects from initial design through permitting and final installation, handling work that ranges from single-home rooftops to multi-building government contracts. The company also repairs orphaned systems left by other installers and performs electrical infrastructure upgrades, including multi-meter buildings and higher-voltage requirements.

OceanHead serves homeowners, commercial property owners, general contractors, manufacturers, and government agencies across Oahu. Commercial projects include flat-roof and carport-mounted solar arrays, fleet EV charging deployments, and full electrical system rebuilds. The company acts as a WOSB/DBE subcontractor on large-scale government solar and electrical work, and partners with contractors needing technical depth for complex installations.

The company emphasizes its local expertise with Hawaii's salt-air and high-UV conditions, designing each system around the specific roof type and structural capacity. It offers an Energy Service Agreement that covers the upfront cost of all services, and manages Hawaiian Electric net-energy-metering applications as part of every commercial installation. The founders state their mission is to make solar and battery storage attainable and long-lasting with no barriers to commitment.

name: Oceanside Welding & Fabrication
old_description: Precision aluminum railings, gates, and fencing for homes and businesses.
about:
Oceanside Welding & Fabrication operates from Oakland Park, Florida, serving Broward and Palm Beach counties. The company was founded by Jerry Menagh, who built the business on years of hands-on welding and aluminum fabrication experience. What began as a small local operation has grown into a family-owned shop known for structural aluminum work across South Florida.

The shop specializes in custom aluminum railings, gates, and fencing for residential and commercial properties, along with lanai column repair, trailer fabrication, and general metal fabrication in aluminum, stainless steel, and mild steel. Work is performed both in-house at their 4340 NE 5th Terrace facility and via mobile welding units. CNC plasma cutting capability is slated to come online soon. Projects run from design through cutting, welding, and installation, with powder coating coordinated as needed.

Customers include homeowners, builders, and property managers throughout South Florida. The company also builds custom trailers for pressure-washing, landscaping, and recreational use. Marine repairs such as pontoon welding have been performed, though the core focus remains architectural and structural aluminum for coastal environments.

Menagh started the business on the principle of doing the job right with pride. The company emphasizes clean welds, corrosion-resistant materials, transparent quoting, and dependable timelines. Its stated values—craftsmanship, integrity, reliability, safety, and community—guide a model that combines in-shop precision with on-site mobility.

The company positions itself as a destination for high‑quality upgrades backed by hands‑on experience, emphasizing that its team understands the intricacies of Toyota and Subaru engines to deliver tailored solutions for horsepower, handling, and efficiency gains.

name: Oh Ghee Inc
old_description: One of the most sacred healing foods with unparalleled therapeutic properties. A superfood for your entire body.
about:
Oh Ghee Inc is based in Bend, Oregon. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

The business produces ghee—a clarified butter rendered from organic butter sourced from grass-fed cows—and extends that core ingredient into a line of skincare products, candles, and pet supplements. Manufacturing steps include butter clarification, blending with herbs for functional foods, formulation of topical creams, and candle pouring. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

Oh Ghee sells directly to consumers through its website, targeting shoppers interested in specialty cooking fats, natural skin care, home fragrance, and pet nutrition. The company does not list industrial or wholesale customers.

The brand positions its ghee as a nutrient-dense superfood rich in omega-3 and omega-9 fatty acids, vitamins A, D, E, and K, antioxidants, amino acids, minerals, and enzymes. It claims the fat is free of inflammatory properties, highly digestible, and serves as a delivery medium for fat-soluble herbs to create therapeutic benefits. Skincare products are marketed for deep hydration and relief from dryness, while the pet line is said to support joint health, coat shine, and digestion.

name: Ohana Fiber Mill
old_description: We make quality fiber from local Hawaiian wool, keeping production close to home and connected to the land. Simple, natural, and made with care.
about:
Ohana Fiber Mill operates in Honokaa on the Big Island of Hawaii. The business was founded by Alisha and Chris, who turned a love for the island into a venture that transforms local wool into sustainable fiber. No founding year is publicly stated.

The mill provides custom fiber processing from raw wool to finished skeins and produces its own 100% Hawaiian-grown and processed yarn blends. Those blends use Merino and Romney wool sourced from Kahua Ranch and other small local fiber producers. The facility is described as a cozy, historic space that also houses a retail store selling handmade items.

The company works directly with local wool producers, makers, farmers, and artists, building a regional network around Hawaiian fiber. Customers include individuals seeking custom processing services and buyers of the mill's own yarn collections.

The founders frame the mill as a way to keep Hawaii's fiber story alive, emphasizing connection to the land, the animals, and the community. The space is also intended as a gathering place for creativity and learning.
